extendedQueries.sql: SELECT tasks.id, tasks.title, tasks.description, tasks.status, tasks.priority, tasks.position, tasks."dueDate", tasks."completedAt", tasks."estimatedHours", tasks.metadata, tasks."createdAt", tasks."updatedAt", tasks."projectId", tasks."assigneeId", tasks."creatorId", tasks."milestoneId", tasks."parentId" FROM tasks tasks ORDER BY tasks."createdAt" DESC LIMIT ?
